name: Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-08
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Takeaways from the Local Rank Academy "Local SEO" (21 PDFs) and "AI SEO" (14 PDFs) lessons, turned into a fix list for Alphalete, Pipeliners and Summit AZ. Because client sites are read-only for Claude, everything is for Kim to apply (Pipeliners and Alphalete titles/metas/schema via Search Atlas OTTO, with autopilot switched to manual first). Course notes themselves: [Local SEO Lesson](lib:brain-local-seo-lesson), [AI SEO Masterclass](lib:brain-ai-seo-masterclass).

# Off-limits (about half the course)
The author sells LocalRank.so and Trackings.ai and much material is black hat. Do not use: coworking/fake GBP addresses or bought profiles, CTR and direction-request manipulation, review gating or paid reviews, seeded Q&A, self-serving AggregateRating schema, LLM PBNs and link networks, paid dofollow links, parasite SEO, Reddit astroturfing, daily mass AI publishing or thin Service x City pages, fake "last updated" bumps. Hype figures (e.g. "#1 on ChatGPT in 10 days") should not be quoted to clients.

# Usable for all clients (25 items, condensed)
- **AEO/GEO on-site:** answer-first blocks on service and city pages; honest comparison pages with real tables; owner-approved price ranges only; original data posts from real job data; local case studies; visible last-updated plus real refreshes using a 1 to 5 scorecard; TOC and HTML tables; About page as an entity page; one consistent boilerplate sentence per client.
- **Technical:** allow AI crawlers and check host bot protection (Summit's SiteGround returned 403 to plain curl on /contact/); Bing Webmaster Tools and Bing Places; one H1, Core Web Vitals, monthly crawl.
- **Schema:** correct LocalBusiness subtype on homepage with sameAs, no aggregateRating; Article schema with Person author and dateModified; FAQPage only for visible FAQs.
- **GBP/citations:** master NAP doc per client (Summit uses real (480) 447-7008 for citations; DNI stays on-site); tiered citation audit; GBP completeness and weekly posts; ethical review program via GHL.
- **Off-site:** monthly "what does AI cite" check; unlinked mention reclamation; ask stale "best of" list authors; earned local links; owner video and profiles.
- **Measurement:** GA4 AI-referral segment; monthly KPI log with dated change log.

# Per-client priorities (live checks 2026-10-08)
- **Alphalete:** biggest risk is about 237 Service x City pages; add real local proof to top cities (Denver, Colorado Springs, Castle Rock, Parker, Monument) and consider consolidating no-proof pages; original scope-data post; CIPP vs bursting vs excavation comparison (pending Scott on bursting); Bing/Apple listings; sameAs; review automation.
- **Pipeliners:** homepage schema wrong type (OTTO outputs ProfilePage/Organization; should be Plumber with address, phone, geo, hours, areaServed, sameAs, fixed in OTTO); unique local proof on city pages OTTO rewrote (impressions down 27 percent), hold until Oct 14/26 checks; comparison pages within wording rules; confirm canonical business name; Bing.
- **Summit AZ:** homepage Plumber node missing address and phone and typed Article (fix in Rank Math Local SEO); two identical homepage H1s; no llms.txt; NAP doc; price content if owner approves; check SiteGround bot protection; Bing/Apple.

# Reusable SOP pieces
Trimmed pre-publish checklist to merge into [SEO Blog Writing Standards](lib:brain-seo-blog-writing-standards); monthly content scorecard; client onboarding audit order.
